prompt:
The Ember does not write letters. An intermediary brings a scrap of cloth — burnt at one corner — and a spoken message.

'You are a builder. I am the other thing. I know what you are because I am the same thing, and I have chosen the other work. We can stand away from each other for a year, or we can stand close and see who loses more.'

branches.label: Accept distance. One year. No acts in the other's strongholds.
branches.result: The messenger leaves without a second word. A year will pass in which the Pyre's ops in your known regions will be quieter. It is not a truce in the formal sense; it is a held breath.

branches.label: Send the cloth back, blackened further, with no message.
branches.result: The Ember, reportedly, laughed. Their tempo in your regions doubles for the year. This will be loud. This will have a cost. You have made an enemy who enjoys the work of being one.

branches.label: Propose a shared target. Let them have the fire; you'll take what's left.
branches.result: A response comes by the same intermediary: 'Name the place.' An emergent destabilisation mandate opens, shaped by the Pyre's hand. You will get the ashes; they will get the burning.

branches.label: Say nothing. Burn the cloth yourself and move on.
branches.result: No reply is sent; no reply is expected. The Ember files you as 'noticed'. Nothing changes this month. Something may change next.
